items.question: Should deities beginning with Tāra be worshipped separately by their own names after bowing?
premises: Deities are named beginning with Tāra.
Each deity is invoked by its own name.
items.inference: The verse prescribes separate worship of each named deity after bowing.
uncertainties: Exact ritual sequence beyond this verse is not specified.
items.plain_english: After bowing, worship the deities beginning with Tāra separately, each by its own name.
